text: さいきん　はまってる　こと…？

structure.jp: さいきん　はまってる　こと…？
structure.en: The thing I've been into lately...?

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.explanation: A verb placed right before a thing describes that thing. はまってる　こと = 'the thing I'm hooked on'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている shows a state that continues; てる is the spoken short form. はまってる = 'I'm hooked on'.
